title: 第11章 自家的东西别人碰一下都嫌脏第12章 这个老六这个混蛋
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 巨大的羞耻和恐惧压倒了之前的害怕，江盼强行稳住心神，脸上挤出一个怯生生的笑容：“多、多谢大王收留！
小妖……小妖一定乖乖听话！”
孙悟空指尖在池边敲出轻响，金瞳里漾着漫不经心的笑：“是呢，听话的孩子才有糖吃，不是吗？”
他朝她勾了勾手，“过来。”
说话间，他往温泉里又沉了沉，双臂随意搭在池边，另外几位大圣也闲适地泡在水里，蒸汽缭绕中，个个都透着股迫人的气势。
江盼脚像钉在原地，脑子里“嗡”
的一声——【过去？往哪去？那温泉里可是围着好几位虎视眈眈的大圣啊！
孙悟空唇角弯得更厉害，语气懒懒散散，却带着不容置疑的意味：“愣着干嘛？过来，让我舒服舒服。”
江盼：“！
腿肚子打颤，脑子里像被塞进一团乱码，全是些少儿不宜的画面。
【舒服？怎么舒服？我日today！
不会、不会现在就要“炒菜”
她红着脸支支吾吾，声音发颤：“我、我能不能不过去？”
她有点想哭:“我笨手笨脚的，哪会伺候人呀……呜呜呜，要不我去给您找几个身段娇俏的姐姐来？”
说着说着，眼泪就真掉下来了，“别、别让我做那个呀！
求求你们了，我才刚化形没多久，还是个孩子呢……”
这话一出，池边瞬间静了静。
孙悟空最先笑出声，他指尖在池边敲得更响了，江盼只觉一股无形的力道缠上腰，“嗖”
地一下就被拽进了孙悟空怀里。
手心猝不及防撞上一片紧实温热的肌理，是孙悟空的腹肌，惊得她指尖都蜷了，脸蛋“腾”
地红了。
孙悟空屈指弹了弹她的额头，语气带着戏谑，“小鱼精脑子里在想什么龌龊东西？”
“我不过是让你给我按按肩，伺候我洗个澡罢了。”
不等江盼松口气，他突然收紧手臂，将她整个人圈得更紧，几乎贴在自己身上。
孙悟空在江盼耳边低语道：“还是说……你其实想让我碰你？”
牛魔王在旁边看得眼热，粗声笑起来：“贤弟，哈哈，这小鱼精凑近了瞧更水灵，不如让兄弟们也尝尝鲜，一起快活快活？”
说着，他的大手就朝江盼胳膊伸过来。
江盼心里瞬间崩溃——【不要啊！
这是要把我当共享宠物吗？我才不要变成公交车！
content_en:
The huge shame and fear overwhelmed the previous fear, Jiang Pan forced himself to calm down, and squeezed out a timid smile on his face: "Thank you, your Majesty, for taking me in!
Little demon...little demon must be obedient! "
Sun Wukong's fingertips tapped lightly on the edge of the pool, with a careless smile in his golden eyes: "Yes, only obedient children can eat sweets, right?"
He hooked his hand at her and said, "Come here."
As he spoke, he sank deeper into the hot spring and rested his arms casually on the edge of the pool. Several other great sages were also soaking leisurely in the water. The steam was swirling around them, and they all had an overwhelming aura.
Jiang Pan's feet felt like they were nailed to the spot, and his mind was "buzzing"
A sound——[Past? Where to go? There were several great sages surrounding the hot spring who were eyeing him eagerly!
The corners of Sun Wukong's lips curved further, and his tone was lazy, but with an unmistakable meaning: "Why are you standing there in a daze? Come here and make me feel comfortable."
Jiang Pan: "!
! "
My calves were trembling, and my mind seemed to be stuffed with gibberish, filled with images that were not suitable for children.
【Comfortable? How comfortable? My day is today!
No, I won’t be “stir-frying” now
Right? !
She blushed and hesitated, her voice trembling: "Can I not go there?"
She wanted to cry a little: "I'm clumsy, how can I serve others... Oooh, how about I find some pretty sisters for you?"
As he spoke, tears really fell down, "Don't, don't let me do that!
Please, I have just transformed, and I am still a child..."
As soon as these words came out, the poolside became silent for a moment.
Sun Wukong was the first to laugh out loud. His fingertips tapped louder on the edge of the pool. Jiang Pan felt an invisible force wrap around his waist, "Whoosh"
He was pulled into Sun Wukong's arms as soon as he hit the ground.
The palm of her hand was caught off guard and hit a piece of tight and warm texture, which was Sun Wukong's abdominal muscles. She was so surprised that her fingertips curled up and her face "swelled"
The ground turned red.
"Tsk,"
Sun Wukong flicked her forehead with his finger, and said in a joking tone, "What dirty things are you thinking in your mind?"
"I just asked you to massage my shoulders and take a shower for me."
Before Jiang Pan could breathe a sigh of relief, he suddenly tightened his arms and hugged her even tighter, almost pressing against him.
Sun Wukong whispered in Jiang Pan's ear: "Or...do you actually want me to touch you?"
The Bull Demon King looked at it with hot eyes and laughed harshly: "Brother, haha, this little fish spirit looks more beautiful when you get closer. Why don't you let the brothers have a try and have a good time together?"
As he spoke, his big hand stretched out towards Jiang Pan's arm.
Jiang Pan's heart collapsed instantly - [No!
Are you treating me as a shared pet? I don’t want to become a bus!
